cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort dinner, then give your spare key back. Have you booked anywhere?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I never gave you a spare key. Where did you get it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll get a table first. Pick somewhere; I'll make the call.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked. Did my sister give you that key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll ask her if she wants to come. Could you add a place if she says yes?

reason: Make the sister diversion an explicit proposed invitation and conditional extra place, not an assumed attendee; A adapts to B completed booking without answering the key-source question.
